name: Ch.2 · The Call to Courage
gameInstructions: Put the preparations in the wisest order. Tap: listen, gather, then go.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: God gave Deborah a message for Barak: gather the people and lead them to Mount Tabor.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Barak was afraid, but Deborah did not shame him.

lines.speaker: deborah
lines.text: Certainly I will go with you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Courage began with a promise that no one had to stand alone.
